shouldFix.title: Eight new leftover-join.vN prose tokens omit their sarif lineage stem.
locations: purpose — five unqualified source tokens: leftover-join.v7 in the fourteen-disclaimer sentence; leftover-join.v4 in the D-325 demotion sentence; leftover-join.v5 in each of the two frozen-v5 landing sentences; and leftover-join.v6 in the frozen-v6 landing sentence
shouldFix.subjectPattern: The affected tokens use bare leftover-join.v4, leftover-join.v5, leftover-join.v6, or leftover-join.v7. Tokens separately carrying a local suffix such as 'leftover-join.v7 of sarif' and file-path tokens were excluded from the count.
shouldFix.refutation: The dispatch expressly attacks leftover-join.vN tokens that are not lineage-qualified. An exhaustive scan of every non-path string leaf found eight such occurrences. The intended referent can be inferred as the sarif lineage, but the token itself does not carry that lineage. This repository contains many distinct leftover-join.v4 through leftover-join.v7 artifacts, and the subject itself cites leftover-join.v7 of G29, so the bare forms are not globally unique. The defect is new in v9: the v8 prose sweep had zero unstemmed leftover-join version tokens; all eight occurrences were introduced in v9's rewritten purpose or newly added finding-disposition leaves.
shouldFix.whyItMatters: Purpose and finding-disposition prose is designed to travel into later custody records. Lifted out of its JSON path, a bare leftover-join.v7 does not identify whether it means sarif, G29, G21, or another lineage. The same sarif lineage previously treated a single unstemmed predecessor-version reference as a SHOULD-FIX carry-safety defect.
shouldFix.whyNotMustFix: The surrounding field names and adjacent fully qualified sarif references make the intended lineage recoverable, and the controlling authorityClaim, basedOn roles, obligation flags, summary partition, and doesNot list all carry the correct fully qualified lineage and standing. No remainder bit, currency pointer, or frozen finding landing is changed by this wording defect.
shouldFix.repairShape: In a frozen successor, qualify each of the eight source tokens locally as sarif leftover-join.vN (or an equally explicit same-token 'of sarif' form). Preserve the frozen v5 and v6 Findings landing at sarif leftover-join.v7. Do not edit v9, v8, v7, v6, v5, v4, COORD, or file 08.

decision.reason: The v8 findings are substantively landed: v8 remains unrecorded, v7 remains the D-325 current recording, v4 is historical, the frozen v5/v6 Findings both land at v7, the fourteen stale consumers now speak as v9, goldenNonauthV3 is historical, and the eight D-344 copies support reducing leftoverDesign to [OBL-FC-OUTFAIL-FX]. Custody and semantic checks are otherwise clean: subject and predecessor unmoved, 104 digest references checked with zero mismatches, HEAD and last-heading custody exact, the eleven-obligation partition exact, and all forbidden authority expansions denied. The zero-SHOULD-FIX rule nevertheless requires REJECT because v9 introduces eight unstemmed leftover-join version tokens in purpose and findingDisposition, creating avoidable cross-lineage ambiguity in precisely the narration intended to travel forward.
decision.pathToAccept: In a frozen successor, locally stem the eight affected prose tokens as sarif leftover-join.vN while preserving every substantive v9 standing and frozen landing. No other repair was identified.
